title: Copy record links to posted Phys. Invt. Order and Recording headers
summary: Record links attached to physical inventory order and recording headers are now copied to their posted documents, matching the behavior of sales, purchase, and warehouse posting flows.
key_points: Record links (Notes and Links factboxes) on physical inventory order and recording headers now carry over to the posted documents
CopyLinks calls added in InsertPostedHeader and InsertPostedRecordings after the posted header inserts
The copy runs inside the existing IsHandled blocks, so subscribers replacing the insert keep control
Regression test posts an order with notes on order and recording and checks the posted headers
No schema, permission or signature changes; purely additive
